70010000122854.description:
RETURN TO THE BEGINNING 
The original Culdcept was released in 1997; a combination of digital board game and deck building, it saw numerous sequels, but that very first game never left Japan, until now!

ROLL THE DICE 
Culdcept The First uses a die (or two sometimes!) to move around the game board, with the aim of gathering a target amount of magic, then returning to the castle to win.  
The spaces on the board are land which can be claimed by summoning a creature to defend them. Land comes in four different colors representing terrain types; these in turn match the creatures’ alignments. Land can also be upgraded, granting additional advantages to its owner.

OVER 300 CARDS 
If an opponent lands on your space, they can either pay a toll or attack your creature with one of their own. In these battles, players can also use special item cards to maximize their chances of winning. Your deck or “book,” consists of 50 cards of various types, with a total of over 300!

NEW FEATURES
Rewind: Jump back in time.
Quick Save & Load: available anytime during the game.
Bonus Pack: Get more reward cards after a match.
Reveal Hands: Keep an eye on yours hand and your opponents'.

STORY 
Humanity was prosperous on the continent of Bablashca. But when mysterious stone tablets appear – fragments of the powerful ancient book, Culdcept –  chaos and conflict follow. 
A lone youth arises to bring peace to the land, and you get to follow along!
70010000122854.intro: The classic fusion of board and card games from 1997 is back and better with modern features!
70010000122854.name: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute

70010000128883.description:
Step into a world ruled by nature, where every sound, footprint, and movement can mean the difference between hunter and prey. Far Primal Survival is an atmospheric prehistoric hunting adventure set 10,000 years ago, where survival depends on patience, awareness, and skill.

Explore untamed territories, track dangerous animals, move silently through tall grass, and use primitive weapons to bring down your prey. Every hunt is a test of your instincts, preparation, and ability to adapt to the wilderness.

Key Features
	•	Track Your Prey – Follow animal tracks and locate hidden prey.
	•	Use Primitive Weapons – Hunt with bows, spears, and clubs.
	•	Complete Hunting Quests – Take on objectives across the wilderness.
	•	Explore 20 Territories – Discover diverse prehistoric environments.
	•	Master the Hunt – Stay hidden, strike carefully, and survive.


The wilderness is vast.
The prey is unpredictable.
Only the patient become the hunter.
70010000128883.intro: Can you become the ultimate hunter in a world ruled by nature?
70010000128883.name: Far Primal Survival

70010000135665.description:
DOTI GOLF turns classic mini golf into a playground of chaos. Every hole hides its own trick - sand traps to slow you down, boost pads to send your ball flying, buttons and rotating bars that shift the course mid-swing, swamps that swallow a bad shot, and even pinball-style bumpers that send you ricocheting toward (or away from) the cup.

Rack up stars on every hole, chase the best par, and work your way through World after World of increasingly devious course design. Whether you're lining up a careful three-putt or gambling on a boost-pad bank shot, DOTI GOLF keeps every hole unpredictable.

Features:
- 5 Worlds featuring 15 holes each - 75 mini golf courses in total
- Wildly varied obstacles: sand, boost pads, buttons, portals, swamps, spikes, and pinball bumpers
- Star rating and par system on every hole
- Solo play, at your own pace
- Sleek, minimalist course design
70010000135665.intro: Putt, bounce, and boost your way through a wildly inventive mini golf adventure!
70010000135665.name: Doti Golf

70010000069053.description:
After the brief peace that followed the wars of the portals that devastated the country, new winds of war threaten its inhabitants when the new king of Imperia together with the Sacred Kingdom have started a war against non-humans, using the services of one of the Last Wizards of Arborea: Trece XIII and their generals, it is the moment of the prophecy, a chosen one will unite Men and beasts to bring peace. Welcome to the world of Arborea, welcome to Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster.

— You are the last of the Beastmaster, use the souls of animals/creatures to transform and progress in the adventure.

— A continuous Metroidvania-style map, open new paths or unlock new routes with your Beastmaster abilities, evil and sorcery lurks in all corners.

— Gather beads for your ritual necklace: you will get fangs, amulets, and plant roots that will change your attacks, vitality, or Mana.

— Enter into a duel in the different Arenas the battle will be with a close camera and energy bars like in the classic fighting games. In the Arena you can enhance your skills and get unique items.

— Find new sword techniques that your old Sensei taught you, use magic potions or summons curses. Thanks to your sword, you can get the power of a god.

— Throughout your adventure you will find many NPCs (Non-Playing Characters) that will give more strength to the narrative of the story, dealing with them will open the possibility of knowing new missions, arcs (as in an Anime series) and complete different endings.
70010000069053.intro: Use your heart-devouring sword to unleash your inner beast and end the threat to Arborea in this hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania.
70010000069053.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster

70010000117319.description:
Toro 2 is a third-person 3D bullfighting simulator that lets you, in its Career Mode, step into the shoes of a bullfighter on his rise to stardom. Travel the world facing the fiercest fighting bulls, avoid getting caught by them, and you’ll become a star in the world of bullfighting.

BECOME A STAR

From the pasture where you made your first cape passes to the world’s largest bullrings. Learn new passes and moves as you prove your worth at the Maestranza in Seville, Las Ventas in Madrid, or La Macarena in Medellín. Thrill the crowd with your elegance and panache, evade the fury of the fiercest bulls, and you’ll become the most famous bullfighter of all time.

YOUR GAME, YOUR BULLFIGHTER

Customize your character to your liking, choose the outfit you’ll wear when entering the ring, and build your arsenal of moves to tailor your style to your gameplay. Inside the bullring, you’re the master of ceremonies, so choose from a wide variety of moves, outfits, and more to make the crowd cheer for your courage.

EVERY BULLFIGHT IS A NEW CHALLENGE

Try to score as many points as possible through your bullfighting, while completing various challenges that will push your skills to the limit. Push your abilities to the max and make the most of the tools at your disposal to reach the pinnacle of bullfighting and become a Master.

TAKE ON YOUR FRIENDS

In the new Versus Mode, you can choose to be either the bull or the matador. Duel with your friends in fast-paced local one-on-one matches, where you’ll decide who controls the matador and who controls the bull. Battle in bullrings around the world and try to outdo your friends. The cunning and finesse of a well-executed pass versus the fury and momentum of a beast weighing hundreds of kilos charging toward you. Who will win?
70010000117319.name: TORO 2

70010000122915.description:
From the desk of VValak Lizardtongue, Grand Shepherd of the Tyrythian Empire:

Well this is just complete and utter bulls**t.

Those idiotic, moronic Terranoids think they can just roll in here and take over my beautiful Tyrythian kingdom? The kingdom that I built from the ground up with my bare hands, and only sort of inherited from my dear, sweet, extremely dead father?

Did I mention that this is bulls**t?

It’s fine though, because what they don’t realize is that I am going to make them very, very dead. Along with my trusty sidekick and childhood nursing bot Milky – please do not ask me questions about that – I will whizz over to Earth, turn it into a stinking pile of rubble, and be back home in time for a warm glass of milk before bed.

Earth Must Die is the story of my glorious rise to power (off the back of my adored father’s passing), my subsequent accidental surrender to the Terranoids, and my infamous revenge against Earth and everything it stands for.

Apparently the story is retold in the form of one of those old point and click adventure games that people gave a sh*t about in the 1990s, I wanna say? But in 2026. Doesn’t sound like a good idea to me, but what do I know – I’m just a benevolent, terrifying leader of worlds who everyone loves and also super respects.

I’m also not sure what the phrase “British comedy royalty” is supposed to mean, but I guess they got a bunch of “funny” f*ckwits to dub over my glorious voyage to feed the Terranoids their own bumholes? Let me just copy/paste the list here so I don’t have to give them any more time and effort than they deserve:

How do I not have someone to do this for me? Anyway, apparently my magnificent story is told over a series of many hours, and you click a bunch and things happen and really I don’t care about any of this, I’m just here for the glory.

VValak signing off.
70010000122915.name: Earth Must Die

70010000001312.description:
Race against the clock, beat tricky puzzles, collect shiny items, and please your evil overlord!

Carrot Man is the beloved hero of the Vegetable Kingdom, and you need to destroy him. There's only one problem: You're the weakest enemy in the game! Despite your powerless nature, you have to stop Carrot Man from saving the kidnapped Princess Pea. Prove to your evil boss – and yourself – that even a small fry can make a BIG difference!

Survive tough-as-nails platforming

The hunt runs through treacherous mazes with tricky platforming. Like any good game goon, you won't stop running even when certain death waits ahead. And trust us, it will! With too many tricks and traps to count, you'll quickly forget how many times you've attempted a level. With new moves to master, like dashing and flying, the challenge ramps up with you! 

Take on extra challenges to uncover hidden secrets!

Seek out a roster of shiny collectibles by completing even more brutal puzzle sequences! With enough practice, you can unlock secret levels, customize your outfit, plug into catchy tunes, and bring to light a secret ending with even more courses to play. If your inner completionist craves a 2D collectathon with tangible rewards, this is the one!

Laugh, cry, and scratch your head in this retro game celebration!

Wunderling DX tells a touching tale of breaking free from the pack with a desire to change the world, even with the odds stacked against you. What starts as a retro game love song soon becomes an unexpected thrill-ride with twists, turns, and alternate endings. All wrapped up in a humorous script from the wild mind of Alex Faciane, accompanied by Ratvader's decade-bending soundtrack!

"Wait, what's new in Wunderling DX?"

Thanks for asking! Wunderling DX is the definitive version of the critically acclaimed Wunderling (2020), featuring tons of new levels, items, story segments, and the previously released content update "Kohlrabi's Ruin" with even more gameplay. The update is free for everyone who's already purchased the game. 

Happy gaming from all of us at Bitwave Games (formerly Retroid)!
70010000001312.intro: All gas, no breaks in this non-stop puzzle platformer!
70010000001312.name: Wunderling DX

70010000054201.description:
Join KUBO in a new adventure that will take you to the four corners of the world in search of the sacred crystals to free the inhabitants kidnapped by the infamous Moglar!

Journey through the underworld, the graveyard, the underwater world, and the skies. Collect the items — there will be many monsters and bosses on your way before the final battle in your enemy's castle!

- Explore four unique worlds: the underworld, the graveyard, the underwater realm, and the skies
- Battle monsters and bosses on the road to Moglar's castle
- Also includes KUBO and KUBO 2
70010000054201.intro: Four worlds. One hero. And the two adventures that started it all.
70010000054201.name: KUBO 3

70010000107505.description:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honour the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals with abilities to shape your strategy. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the sacrificial lamb, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

Conquer the realm through two distinct adventures:

The First Campaign pits you against a growing rebellion as you try to maintain the king’s good and just rule (objectively). Battle your way through a challenging environment filled with deep pits and poison swamps as you try to suppress your enemies. As you progress, you may start to wonder if there are more to the kingdom’s troubles than meet the eye? 

The Second Campaign introduces a new threat - gunpowder. As new experimental weapons now enter the battlefield, your strategy must change. No longer are you simply avoiding the environmental hazards - you must dodge an onslaught of bullets to ensure you and your troops are not fatally wounded as you march forth. 

Each campaign features unique cards, bosses, and strategic challenges. The battlefield awaits your command!
Intuitive Yet Deep Gameplay - Easy to learn without compromising on the challenge
Roguelike Progression - Every run is different
Card Permadeath - Lost cards stay lost!
Charming Art Style - Picture-book visuals blend with medieval absurdity and dark humour
Memorable NPC Encounters - Are they friend or foe?
Special Boss Mechanics - Unique challenges that will test you
Gradual Difficulty Ladder - Climb through harder and harder difficulties as you progress
Challenge Modes - Test your skills in special modes with unique rules
Relics - Collect relics with various effects that change how you play

From an ancient royal decree:

"The art of war is simple. Send forth your subjects to die gloriously in your name. Their sacrifice ensures your legacy... and if they happen to win, all the better!"

Will you write your name in the annals of history, or become just another forgotten monarch? The balance between loss and triumph is yours to master.

All hail! May your fallen be remembered  and your victories sweet!
70010000107505.intro: Sacrifice creates stories in this medieval roguelike deckbuilder. Watch your cards march to glory or permanent death as they battle toward the enemy.
70010000107505.name: The Royal Writ

70010000110297.description:
Clockwork Rabbit is a relaxing single-player isometric puzzle game set in a steampunk world inhabited by adorable bunnies.

Meet Tessa, a young mechanic working in a textile factory in Clockwork Town, where every room hides a new challenge.

The game blends time manipulation, action planning, helper robot programming, and creative puzzle solving. With no time limits, you can play at your own pace and enjoy a calm, laid-back experience.

Key features:
A calm and thoughtful puzzle experience
Single-player adventure with narrative background
Isometric perspective
Time manipulation mechanics
No violence, no ads, no microtransactions
Stylized visuals and a unique atmosphere
Suitable for both experienced and new players
Crafted with passion by an independent team

Jump into the rabbit hole with Tessa and try to catch that bunny!
70010000110297.intro: Tessa works as a mechanic in a textile factory. A puzzle game with hand-crafted puzzles based on manipulating time. A cute story about sweet bunnies.
70010000110297.name: Clockwork Rabbit

70010000117015.description:
Use "game" as a medium to showcase the world of "you/girl". Explore the truth of "you/girl/world" through the form of a "visual novel".

A surreal psychological horror short visual novel where YOU are the protagonist.

One day, a mysterious girl suddenly appears in the protagonist's room...

Your task is simple:
-Say hello to the girl~
-Navigate through hundreds of choices to respond to "the girl's existence."
-Explore the essence of "being" and uncover the truth of this "world."

And your mission is even simpler:
-Say hello to the girl~
-As king, listen to your subjects' counsel, especially those "loyal ministers."
-Make strawberry cake, eat the cake, eat the cake - will you really let her eat the cake?
-Stop FONTAINEBLEAU's plot! Don't hand over the time machine!
-Journey to the Silvery Forest, defeat the Demon Lord, fulfill the Dreamer's mission.
-Date the mysterious girl at the world's end.
-Take some pills, have a heart-to-heart chat with them.
-Witness your ending with the girl.

Of course, perhaps none of that matters most. What matters is...

I hope you enjoy our time together.
70010000117015.name: The NOexistenceN of you AND me

70010000123867.description:
Tiny Dino Learning Academy is the perfect first learning game for preschoolers! Featuring 15 carefully crafted mini games set in a vibrant prehistoric world full of adorable and lovable dinosaurs, this is early education at its most exciting.

Using simple and intuitive controls, children count dinosaurs, compare groups, train their memory, recognise numbers and dice, and discover which dinosaur is biggest or fastest — all brought to life with beautiful animations and delightful sounds designed to keep little ones engaged and motivated. 
Whether played together on the couch or explored independently, Tiny Dino Learning Academy makes every learning moment feel like a grand prehistoric adventure. 

WHAT YOUR CHILD WILL LEARN 
Counting and number recognition Comparing groups and sizes Memory and observation skills Logical ordering and sequencing Species recognition and categorisation 

15 MINI GAMES INCLUDE 
Did you see this dinosaur? Which group is bigger? Find the fastest and biggest dinosaur Count all dinosaurs and species Numbers and dice in the correct order Dinosaurs coming out of magical eggs Memory and much more!
70010000123867.intro: 15 preschool mini games with adorable dinosaurs!
70010000123867.name: Tiny Dino Learning Academy

70010000125669.description:
“Which one is the alpaca?” “Which one is nutmeg?”

Everything that appears is something you’ve probably heard of before.
But the moment four photos are placed in front of you, you might suddenly find yourself unsure.

The rules are simple: just choose the correct answer from four options.
No expert knowledge required. All you need is your common sense.

Up to 8 players can join in on a single console.
Grab your controllers and start battling right away.
Choose from 10, 20, or 30 questions, making it perfect for both a quick game and a longer challenge.

You answer with complete confidence—only to be the one person who gets it wrong.
You make a random guess—and somehow get it right.
The biggest laughs might not come from getting the answer right, but from that moment when someone says, “Wait, you didn’t know that?”

A single-player mode is also included for those who want to take on the challenge at their own pace.
With 100 stages in total, how far will your common sense take you?

Play with family, friends, or at parties.
Whether you’re a trivia expert or not, everyone competes on equal footing.
70010000125669.intro:
Can you spot common sense in a picture?
Expose what everyone only thinks they know.
Up to 8 players. The common-sense battle starts now.
70010000125669.name: Party Fun! 8-Player Common Sense Battle

70010000127617.description:
Step into a realm of high fantasy where a legendary wizard’s apprentice wields arcane orbs with the flick of a wand! Choose your stage, aim your magic-infused spheres at winding stone paths, and match three or more identical elements to trigger spectacular spells before they invade your inner sanctum. Achieve legendary scores and earn three mystical stars per level by dispelling waves with magical precision.
Between your quests, spend your earned mana-gold to unlock ancient wizardly upgrades:
Dragon’s Breath: Scorches clusters with a torrential blast of fire.
Chronos Shift: Freezes the flow of orbs in their tracks.
Alchemy Orb: Transmutes your next sphere into any element you desire.
Starfall Barrage: Calls down a rain of meteors to clear the path.
Arcane Bolt: Shatters a single, stubborn orb with concentrated energy.
Rewind Rune: Reverses the stream, granting you a second chance at a perfect match.
Journey through four enchanting realms—the Whispering Elf-Woods, the Floating Sky-Castles, the Frost-Giant Peaks, and the Shadow-Dragon’s Lair. Every ten levels, the magic shifts to reveal new paths, rarer orb colors, magical barriers, and intensifying speeds.
Addictive and easy to learn yet challenging to master, this epic adventure delivers spellbinding arcade fun for wizards and warriors of all ages.
70010000127617.intro: Master the mystic arts—match arcane orbs and save the kingdom from the surge!
70010000127617.name: Zumba – Magical Marble Saga

70010000128944.description:
Grab your racket and face your rivals! Compete in prestigious tournaments, collect trophies and become world number one.

Equip yourself with top-class rackets and balls. Master your shots and perfect your forehand, backhand, serve and volley. Play in 10 stunning stadiums inspired by the most iconic real-world venues.
70010000128944.intro: Get ready for intense clashes on the most challenging courts!
70010000128944.name: Tennis Legend 2026

70010000129224.description:
A broken error screen. A missing file. And somehow, on the other side of that 404, a girl who shouldn't exist is looking right at you.

Take on a mix of minigames built to test you in different ways. Beat them and every one unlocks a piece of the gallery, pushing you closer to her.

Some crash the system on purpose. Some just want to be found. Each one glitches into your game with her own personality, her own rules, her own way of making you work for it.

How many errors are you willing to chase before one of them finally lets you in?


Features:

● A VARIETY OF MINIGAMES: Different challenges test you in different ways. Clear them and the gallery unlocks as you go.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Every win cracks the error screen open a little more.

● GLITCHY, UNFORGETTABLE PERSONALITIES: Each anime girl comes with her own attitude, quirks and reasons for showing up in your game uninvited.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: How you play decides who stays and who logs off for good.

● A HIDDEN MOMENT AT QUESTION 150: Something's buried deep in the code. Most players never see it.


The system says bug error 404. 
Your heart says otherwise. 
Boot it up and prove the error wrong.
70010000129224.intro:
Somewhere between the code and the crash, she's waiting for you. 
Fix the glitch and she's all yours!
70010000129224.name: Bug Error 404: Anime Girls Not Found

70010000129243.description:
The screen glitches. The error reads 404. And staring back at you through the broken code is a guy who was never supposed to load.

Take on a mix of minigames built to test you in different ways. Beat them and every one unlocks a piece of the gallery, pushing you closer to him.

Some of them crashed the system just to get your attention. Others are glitches trying to stay hidden. Each one carries his own personality into your game, and his own way of testing whether you're worth sticking around for.

How many broken screens are you willing to fix before one of them finally stays?


Features:

● A VARIETY OF MINIGAMES: Different challenges test you in different ways. Clear them and the gallery unlocks as you go.

● UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE IMAGES: Every win cracks the error open a little more.

● PERSONALITIES THAT GLITCH INTO YOUR LIFE: Each anime boy brings his own attitude, his own quirks, his own reason for breaking into your game.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Your choices decide who stays online and who logs off for good.

● A HIDDEN MOMENT AT QUESTION 150: Something's buried in the code. Most players never find it.


The bug error 404 says he doesn't exist. 
Fix the glitch and find out for yourself!
70010000129243.intro:
He shouldn't be there. The error screen says so. 
Track him down and see for yourself.
70010000129243.name: Bug Error 404: Anime Boys Not Found

70010000129736.description:
This black cat has mastered the art of camouflage! Can you spot him?

Cats Around Us: Black Cat is the second part of the series where you search for hidden furballs inside a five-page silent comic. 

Follow a super sweet story about a man and his sneaky black kitty who just loves blending into the shadows!

- 200+ hidden objects, 5 pages comic and a jigsaw puzzles
- Photo & Paint Mode to capture and color your scene
- Adjustable game colours, brightness, and contrast!
70010000129736.intro: Spot hidden cats in a comic book about a sneaky black kitty!
70010000129736.name: Cats Around Us: Black Cat

70010000131530.description:
Take on the ultimate takoyaki challenge on Nintendo Switch™!
Add the batter and ingredients, then flip the takoyaki with a pick!
Play with up to 4 players using one Joy-Con™ controller each!

Enjoy a variety of game modes!
Cause chaos with items and random events in Party Battle, test your skills against friends in Battle, or make takoyaki to order in Score Attack!

Become a takoyaki master!

《Rules》
Make takoyaki using a takoyaki maker!
The better they turn out, the more points you earn!
Make as many as you can before time runs out!

《How to Play》
1. Fill each hole in the pan with batter and ingredients.

2. When the takoyaki starts to brown, use a pick to flip it over! Be careful not to act too quickly or too slowly! Once both sides are fully cooked, the takoyaki is done!

[Party Battle]
The feature mode of Super Takoyaki Battle is "Party Battle!"
Chaos erupts as up to 4 players compete on one giant grill!
Unique events occur to change the flow of the match!
Use items to gain the advantage over your opponents!
It's anyone's game until the very last second!

[Score Attack]
Master 3 different makers—home, food stall, and commercial—each with its own unique challenges!
Cook up as many takoyaki as you can, fill orders, and aim for a high score!

[Battle] 
Compete with up to 4 players to see who's the ultimate takoyaki chef!
You can also challenge CPU opponents!

[Rankings]
Compete for high scores against players from around the world!
Become a takoyaki master!
70010000131530.intro:
Experience takoyaki-making like never before!
Make as many as you can in an all-out battle!
70010000131530.name: Super Takoyaki Battle

70010000131749.description:
What makes one tiny detail turn into a big online moment?

Everyone has wondered why some things catch fire while others get ignored. If you have ever dreamed of growing from an unknown creator into someone people notice, this is your chance to test that instinct.

Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream is a casual picture-solving game where you read the prompt, scan the image, and choose the single spot that best matches. Clear stages as you chase the feeling of climbing toward influencer fame.

How to play:
・Check the prompt
・Look carefully across the image
・Select the one matching spot

Some stages are easy to read at a glance, while others reward a sharper eye and a little social-media sense. Each round is quick, but finding the right detail can feel surprisingly satisfying.

Play a stage whenever you have a moment, or take on all 150 at your own pace. Start your influencer dream and see how far your instincts can carry you.
70010000131749.name: Aim for 1 Million! Influencer Dream

70010000132215.description:
Learn Japanese hiragana with simple picture-based word puzzles!

Look at the picture and the incomplete Japanese word, then choose the correct hiragana from four options. Familiar objects and clear illustrations make the questions easy to understand, even for beginners.

How to play:
・Look at the picture and the word with a missing character
・Choose the correct hiragana from 4 options
・Try to complete all 120 questions

Simple button controls make it easy to start playing right away. If you get stuck, hints are available so you can keep learning at your own pace.

Recommended for:
・Beginners learning Japanese hiragana
・Children starting to study Japanese
・Players who want to learn Japanese words with pictures
・Families who enjoy solving questions together
・Anyone looking for short and casual learning sessions

Use the pictures as clues and find the missing hiragana. Can you complete all 120 questions?
70010000132215.intro:
Learn hiragana with pictures!
Choose the missing character from 4 options
120 fun and easy Japanese word puzzles!
70010000132215.name: Play & Learn: My First Hiragana

70010000132397.description:
Circuit Flow is a wire-routing puzzle game set on a compact circuit board. Draw traces to connect colored signals from the board edge to their matching components - LEDs, speakers, fans, and displays all need the right current to power up.

Start simple with single-color routes, then tackle resistors that transform signal colors, splitters that break secondaries into primaries, and mixers that combine them into new ones. Plan your paths carefully - wires can't overlap, and a wrong turn means a short circuit.

Features:
- Hand-crafted puzzle levels with progressive difficulty
- Color mixing and splitting mechanics
- Circuit designer - build and share your own levels
- Arcade mode with procedurally generated boards
- Encyclopedia of real electronic components
- Clean, readable circuit board visual style
70010000132397.intro: Route the signal. Power the board.
70010000132397.name: Circuit Flow

70010000132831.description:
What if the quietest scene held the biggest clue?

You know that feeling when something looks normal… until it suddenly doesn’t.

This is a casual picture puzzle game where each round shows one illustration and one prompt. Study the scene, compare the details, and choose the single spot that answers the question.

・Read the prompt
・Check the illustration carefully
・Choose the one place that fits

Every stage is quick to play, but the right answer may be tucked among similar-looking details. Trust your eyes, take a closer look, and enjoy that little aha moment when the room finally gives itself away.

Ready to uncover the truth hiding in plain sight?
70010000132831.intro: Can you read an empty room?
70010000132831.name: The Truth of the Empty Room

70010000132843.description:
Some rumors sound too strange to be true... but that is exactly what makes you want to check.

We have all heard a story that someone swore was real. When the clue is an image, can you tell what actually adds up?

This is a 4-choice image quiz with an urban-mystery mood: quick questions, surprising explanations, and a casual pace that makes it easy to keep going.

・Look closely at the image
・Compare the 4 choices
・Choose the answer that seems most convincing
・Read the explanation after you answer

Getting it right feels great, but even a miss can teach you a fun new angle.

Play a round whenever you have a few minutes, and see how well you can separate rumor from reality.
70010000132843.intro: Can you trust what you see?
70010000132843.name: How True Is This Rumor? Urban Legend Mystery

70010000132855.description:
Ready to make English practice a little spooky?

You may have studied English before, but using it in a story can feel totally different.

This is a casual four-choice image quiz inspired by ghost stories from around the world. Look at the picture, feel the mood, and pick the answer that best fits.

・Look closely at the image
・Read the four answer choices
・Choose the one you think is correct
・Check the explanation after answering

Whether you get it right or miss it, each round gives you another chance to absorb useful English in a memorable way.

Play a few questions whenever you want and see how naturally the phrases start to stick.
70010000132855.intro: Can ghost stories teach you English?
70010000132855.name: Learn English with World Ghost Stories

70010000133306.description:
Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about survival and growth in a fragile garden.

Guide your garden through a magical calendar, making daily choices between unpredictable weather conditions. Each day brings new risks and opportunities, forcing you to manage resources, protect your flowers, and adapt to an ever-changing world.

At the center of your journey lies a single black seed — a rare and mysterious chance to change your fate, if you can make it bloom.

Every run is different. Skill matters, but success is never guaranteed.

Features:
-Strategic roguelike gameplay where every run brings new knowledge.
-Experiment, learn, predict, and adapt your strategy to achieve your goal.
-Unlock over 80 achievements and discover new ways to influence the world.
-Combine tools, devices, enchantments, and weather effects to overcome every challenge.
-A relaxing yet challenging experience where careful planning competes with unpredictable chaos.
-Handcrafted art and a magical atmosphere.
-Learn through experimentation—knowledge is your true progression.
70010000133306.intro: In this strategic roguelike survival game, knowledge is your true progression. Grow flowers, gather resources, and use clever combinations of tools, devices, charms and weather to make the
70010000133306.name: Black Flower

70010000134408.description:
2048 Battles – Sylvan Sirens puts an enchanting spin on the classic 2048 puzzle formula! Slide tiles to combine matching numbers and launch devastating attacks against a coven of woodland foes. Fight your way through alluring sirens, spell-weaving forest witches, and majestic fae queens—each wielding wild nature magic and a flair for the dramatic.

Strategically smash high-value tiles into your foes to deal damage and disrupt their sylvan spells. Each enemy brings unique abilities to the battle: some ensnare your tiles in thorns, others drain your power, and a few can twist the grid with tangling roots. With five difficulty levels, the challenge adapts to your skill.

Once you've tamed the wildwood, take on Infinite Mode for a pure puzzle experience. Combine tiles, stack up high numbers, and see how long you can flourish in the ever-growing forest. 

Will you master the wilds and become the ultimate puzzle champion?
70010000134408.intro: Combine tiles and battle cute elves in a realm of fae!
70010000134408.name: 2048 Battles – Sylvan Sirens

70070000039917.description:
Take on two hands-on business adventures where restoration, management, and smart investments are the keys to success.
Restore a neglected hotel from the ground up. Clear out damaged rooms, renovate floors, walls, and ceilings, choose furniture and decorations, welcome guests, and expand your property as your business grows. Improve your tools, unlock new rooms, and transform an abandoned building into a successful hotel.
Then enter the world of car dealing. Search auctions for promising vehicles, compete for the best deals, repair and restore your purchases, and sell them for profit. Customize and expand your showroom, manage your budget, negotiate with customers, and build your reputation as your collection of vehicles and your dealership continue to grow.
With two distinct management experiences, this bundle lets you renovate, customize, trade, expand, and build your way toward success - whether you're creating the perfect hotel or running your own car empire.
70070000039917.intro: Build your empire from the ground up.
70070000039917.name: Business Simulator Collection

70070000039918.description:
Three unforgettable adventures, three completely different challenges.
Fight your way through a zombie-infested Wild West, where relentless hordes, powerful bosses, unique characters, weapons, perks, and loyal companions await. Build your ultimate combination of abilities, explore cursed frontier locations, and survive increasingly dangerous battles.
When the guns fall silent, switch to a quieter adventure and become a curious little cat exploring a luxurious hotel. Wander through cozy interiors, sneak into different areas, jump across furniture, discover hidden corners, and complete playful tasks from a unique feline perspective.
And when you're ready for a real test of patience, take control of a fearless kitty in a challenging vertical climbing adventure. Jump from object to object, climb higher, master precise movements, and try to reach the top without losing your progress.
From battling zombie hordes to peaceful hotel exploration and precision-based climbing, this bundle brings together three unique experiences united by one thing - every adventure has its own way to challenge.
70070000039918.intro: Survive, explore, reach to the top.
70070000039918.name: Strays & Wild West Collection

70070000039919.description:
Enter two horror experiences where places hide something deeply disturbing.
In one nightmare, a seemingly ordinary office becomes a place of isolation and paranoia. Spend a long, silent night wandering through empty corridors and familiar workspaces as reality slowly begins to shift. Everything looks normal - but the longer you stay, the harder it becomes to trust your surroundings.
In the second experience, luxury and terror collide in a cursed royal hall. Trapped for six nights with an ever-growing debt, you must rely on a sinister slot machine to survive. Manage your luck, collect powerful artifacts, make risky deals with a mysterious entity, and gamble your way toward freedom while something in the darkness watches your every move.
Two different nightmares, two dangerous situations, and one common rule: the longer you stay, the stranger things become.
70070000039919.name: Nightmare Roulette Pack

70070000040004.description:
Silverwind Saga:
Rynna has arrived on one of Shalnor's most dangerous islands. Once a haven for tourism, now the island is abandoned due to the presence of the Slime Queen. To prove her worth, our young Elven hero has to overcome the challenges of the island by finding powerful weapons and items to use against the hordes of monsters in challenging gauntlet-style combat encounters.

Silvewind Saga 2:
An evil Necromancer has brought ruin upon an already dangerous island.

It's up to Rynna to fight her way through hordes of monsters and undead beings, and defeat the Necromancer and his minions and free the souls of those who have been trapped in the world of the living.
70070000040004.intro: Two RPG/Action Adventure games. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights and beautiful pixel-art scenery.
70070000040004.name: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga Bundle

70010000125248.description:
Extinction is not an option. The fate of your entire species rests in your claws!

In Dino Odyssey, you control a brave dinosaur on a dangerous journey to rescue the eggs of your kind, ensuring the survival and birth of new generations.

Run, jump, and use your wits to explore a world full of threats. Every egg collected is a breath of hope to save your species from disappearing forever!


Features:
* 50 different levels
* Over 20 unique mechanics
* 3 different biomes
* Handcrafted pixel art visuals and retro soundtrack
70010000125248.intro: You have to complete this dangerous journey to survive extinction!
70010000125248.name: Dino Odyssey

70010000131127.description:
Speed is only the beginning. The real challenge starts in every corner.

Push your car to the limit, enter corners at high speed, and control every slide with precision. Chain smooth drifts, maintain your momentum, and chase higher scores while competing in intense street races.

Winning takes more than raw speed. Your entry angle, drift control, racing line, and exit timing all matter. Every corner is an opportunity to gain an advantage, improve your run, and prove your driving skills.

Feel the rush of fast cars, sharp turns, and perfectly controlled drifts as you fight for better results and cleaner runs. Easy to pick up but rewarding to master, every race gives you another reason to come back and improve.

Features:

High-speed drift racing
Skill-based driving and precise car control
Competitive street races where speed and style both matter
Challenging tracks and corners built for drifting
Accessible gameplay with plenty of depth to master
Chase higher scores and improve your best runs
Fast-paced racing atmosphere focused on cars, speed, and drifting

Hit the road, leave your mark on the asphalt, and prove you can master every corner.
70010000131127.intro: Master the streets. Own every drift.
70010000131127.name: Drift Club: Street Legends

70010000132732.description:
An old factory district has stood silent for decades after a series of unexplained disappearances forced everyone to leave. Locals say the entire area is cursed, bound by ancient voodoo relics hidden throughout the abandoned buildings.

Determined to end the nightmare, you enter the district with one goal: find every cursed relic and break the curse once and for all. But as you search through abandoned factories, rusting warehouses, dark alleyways, and forgotten offices, you realize something else still calls this place home..

Features:
>Explore a large abandoned factory district.
>Search for cursed voodoo relics to break the curse.
>Evade a GIANT creature that relentlessly stalks the shadows.
>Experience immersive first-person horror with atmospheric environments.
70010000132732.name: Cursed District: Horror

70010000133265.description:
Hockey Beasts is a colorful, casual hockey game in which the player takes on the role of a member of one of the animal teams and tries to prove which of them deserves to be called the best. Play locally with up to 4 players, or take the competition online with up to 6 players.

Pick your favourite squad: from stubborn bulls and speedy monkeys to crocodiles, elephants, giraffes, and other rink-ready beasts. Every team plays differently, so choosing a character is not just about looks. Some are quick and agile, others rely on strength, reach, or a more patient approach.

The controls are simple enough to understand from the first match, but winning consistently takes timing, positioning, and a good read of your opponent. It is easy to play, hard to master, and built around short matches that are just as enjoyable during a relaxed solo session as they are in a competitive multiplayer game.

Expect expressive cartoon characters, colorful arenas, messy rebounds, awkward collisions, and goals that sometimes feel brilliant and sometimes completely accidental.
70010000133265.intro: Choose your team, step onto the ice, and see what kind of beast you are when the puck starts moving.
70010000133265.name: Hockey Beasts

70010000134447.description:
Quiz Challenge Multiplayer is the quiz game that turns your couch into a game show stage.

Answer questions across two great fields of knowledge — History and Science — each split into a wide range of themes. From ancient civilizations to modern events, from astronomy to chemistry, every session mixes things up so no two games feel the same.

GRAB A CONTROLLER, GRAB YOUR FRIENDS
Play solo to train at your own pace, or gather up to 4 players in local multiplayer. No account, no connection, no waiting — just pass the pad or take a controller each and start.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

STANDARD — Classic quiz rules. Take your time, think it through, and answer correctly to score.
BATTLE — Speed is everything. The faster you lock in the right answer, the more points you take. Hesitate, and your opponents leave you behind.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
Every question is a chance to pick something new up. History and Science are only half of it: the game is fully playable in English, French, German and Spanish, so you can switch to the language you're learning and train your vocabulary while you play. It's a quiz night and a language lesson in one.

FEATURES

Hundreds of questions across History and Science
Multiple themes within each category
1 to 4 players, local multiplayer
Standard and Battle modes
4 fully localized languages: English, French, German, Spanish
Pick up and play — perfect for family evenings and party sessions

How much do you really know? Time to find out.
70010000134447.intro: History & Science quiz, 1 to 4 players, in English, French, German, Spanish.
70010000134447.name: Quiz Challenge Multiplayer

70070000038319.description:
Your adventure begins with Food Truck Tycoon. Cook, chop, bake and enjoy hundreds of unique dishes.

But the journey of a thousand dishes is just the beginning!

As you hone your cooking skills and build your reputation with food trucks, you'll be given the opportunity to explore more gourmet games as DLC.

Customize your kitchen with countless upgrades and serve delicious food in different locations. Keep the grill hot, keep your customers smiling, sauté, mix and serve to the top.

Face cooking challenges to become the ultimate chef in town!

So put on your apron, sharpen your knives and enter the cooking arena. Life is a party - let's cook delicious!

This bundle contains "Cooking Arena", "Sweet Bakery Tycoon", "Food Truck Tycoon Asian Cuisine" and "Pizza Bar Tycoon".
70070000038319.intro: Universe bursting with flavors and culinary adventures awaits!
70070000038319.name: Cooking Arena Grand Edition

70070000038321.description:
Inspired by the classics, developed for the modern audiences.

A classic revenge story set in a medieval fantasy world… with a touch of deadly modern firepower just to turn things up to eleven. Fight through the armies of undead, mutants, aliens, machines and beasts in order to get back what is rightfully yours and bring some semblance of peace back to the land. Who knows - if you’re thorough enough you might even discover the history of the kingdom itself, long lost to the scholars of the realm.

Knights & Guns brings you to a dangerous world where you will fight, alongside your friend, against demons, ghouls & ghosts. Use shotguns, lasers and the power of chivalry to overcome every obstacle. Become the best version of a knight - one with a gun.

Inside the game:
•	Fight awesome bosses on various stages! 
•	Conquer the non-linear world! Rush through over 150 hand crafted stages, or enjoy the game at your own pace, looking for secrets and special routes!
•	Entire game designed for both single player or co-op multiplayer. Invite a friend at any time for some extra firepower and mayhem.
•	60 fps gameplay! Try the different modes! Hunt the monsters! Survive! Play on small, big and narrow maps!
•	Check out all the awesome suits of armor and, of course, all the GUNS! Lasers, shotguns, grenade launchers, sniper rifles... They are all here!
•	Over 30 unique guns. (That’s probably more flavors of death than flavors of ice cream you can name.)
•	Over 25 types of enemies, 5 types of mini-bosses and 3 types of bosses. Most of these come in different colors, too.
•	30 unique suits of armor for the knights. Extra protection and extra style!
•	Traps, chests, keys, scrolls of lore, books of monsters...

This bundle includes base game, Armor Pack #1, Armor Pack #3 and Armor Pack #4 with:

- 5 new armors to help you on your quest
70070000038321.intro: Knight in shining armor, fight your way... with Guns!
70070000038321.name: Knights & Guns VIP Edition

70070000038323.description:
Urban Flow is a game about the subtle beauty of city streets filled with cars moving in perfect harmony. But such order does not happen all by itself - the city needs YOU to control the traffic lights and to make sure everything goes smoothly. That means no crashes, no jams. Everything will run perfectly - as long as you stay focused!

Immerse yourself in a beautiful, hand-crafted, low-poly world to discover the enormous satisfaction of watching the hundreds of tiny, colorful cars flowing through the streets – all while listening to the chill, urban music.

Over 100 levels, each with its own busy intersection. You have one job: operate the lights and keep it safe.

Party Game (even if you party all alone!)
-----
 Play by yourself or with friends in scalable drop-in, drop-out local co-op mode for two, three, or four players!
You can help your friends or be a little rascal and spread the chaos!

Avoid accidents by paying close attention to special vehicles and to the other players. Special vehicles include the ambulance, which can’t wait for long, and the tank – which will plow through anything in its way.

Don’t want to play the campaign?
-----
 Try our score-based Endless Mode or the Chill Mode - where you play for as long as you want, no rush and no score - only you and the music. Urban Flow is designed to be a great single player experience!

Discover various environments and weather conditions. Play with touch controls, Pro Controllers or Joy-Con™ controllers. Complete challenges and unlock rewards.

Become one with the flow. The Urban Flow!

This bundle includes base game, Streets Supplement, Streets Supplement #2 and Streets Supplement #3 with:

•    15 new vehicles
70070000038323.intro: Manage the city lights and try to avoid the chaos!
70070000038323.name: Urban Flow Omega Edition

70070000038671.description:
Put your dueling instincts to the test in one-on-one matches!

Choose from multiple characters with their signature ability shots.
Pick their looks from the list of available outfits.
Make them better players by improving their stats!

Challenge your mates in one-on-one local multiplayer mode! 

Shoot, block, shove and dunk your way through tournaments to unlock additional characters.

The must-have game for all basketball lovers!

GAME FEATURES:

* 19 different characters with their own signature ability shots and unique looks
* Two different single player modes (League and Challenge)
* COMPETE 1-ON-1 IN LOCAL MULTIPLAYER MODE (Versus)
* Improve your character by leveling up and upgrading their stats
* Amazing graphics, music and sound effects
* 36 achievements to complete
* 10 statistics to track your progress and beat

This bundle contains main title, Street Style Kit #1 and Street Style Kit #2, with:

- 2 new sets of jersey, shorts and boots
70070000038671.name: Street Basketball Silver Edition

70070000038673.description:
No matter if it's your first time playing poker, or you’re a seasoned veteran, with this game you will sharpen your skills and experience the thrill of winning big at the poker table! 

You can play with AI or up to 6 players in local multiplayer mode. There are five difficulty levels, and lots of customisation features: 

- Custom Blinds
- Round time limit
- Shop with over 20 different tables, floors and table materials 
- 10 card artwork styles to choose from
- Player avatars

… and more! Check it out and enjoy a crash course in probability, psychology, and game theory.

This bundle contains main title, Cards Set #1 and Cards Set #2, with:

- 2 new sets of averses and reverses for cards
70070000038673.name: Poker - Texas & Omaha Hold'em Silver Edition

70010000133560.description:
Play as a frog and jump through a space-themed obstacle course filled with floating platforms, jump pads, moving obstacles, and dangerous traps. Complete every level while avoiding the endless void below.

For the ultimate challenge, try Hardcore Mode. All checkpoints are disabled, so one mistake sends you back to the beginning.

Features:
>Play as a frog in outer space.
>Complete challenging parkour levels.
>Leap across floating and moving platforms.
>Avoid traps, obstacles, and the endless void.
>Attempt Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.
70010000133560.intro: One small hop for a frog, one giant leap through space!
70010000133560.name: Space Parkour Obby

70010000134520.description:
TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

Manage Your Shop:
Design your own TCG shop. Organize shelves and card packs to make the customer shopping experience smooth and easy. "

Card Collection:
Open the booster packs yourself and collect the cards. Find rare cards and sell them to make a fortune, or keep them to complete your card collection.

Host Game:
Set your card game format and fee, invite players to play card games in your shop. Be sure to keep your store clean and hygienic for the players or they might leave!"

Order Products:
Stock up on different booster card packs and card game products. Keep track of popular trends and adjust your inventory to cater to the ever-changing demands of your customers.

Expand Your Business:
Earn profits to reinvest in your shop. Expand your space, unlock new card sets, and upgrade your facilities to attract even more customers and increase revenue.
70010000134520.intro: Sell cards, build your collection, run tournaments and earn money and build your card shop business.
70010000134520.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator

70010000061751.description:
A service industry apocalypse

Welcome to Roman Sands RE:Build, an apocalyptic trip from the studio behind the IGF Award-winning Paratopic.

A shape-shifting absurdist adventure that twists two stories together, taking you from a luxury tropical resort to post-apocalyptic survival.

Two stories of escape

The Resort
Wash up on the beach of an indulgent Resort. According to the guests, you work here—AND you're slacking off. Race against time to rank up and earn equipment to stem their never-ending tide of demands. The only catch to your employment: the sun is days away from swallowing the world, and the guests couldn't care less.

Look under the surface: uncover the resort's secrets and solve puzzles in an attempt to escape.

Cling to life after the end

The Facility
One of the last people left alive, you are the caretaker of a decaying zoological research station. Your only companions are a dead cow and a voice on the radio; it sounds familiar, but ... from where?

A parasite clogs the guts of your station: will you exterminate it and preserve the station's work, even at the cost of your own survival?

Manic genre mashup

Are these worlds the same? When are they? WHAT are they!? Two distinct narratives overlap and mutate in a delirious genre apocalypse: adventure, visual novel, puzzle solving, survival simulation, and atmospheric horror collide to tell a story of escaping the inescapable.
70010000061751.intro: A service industry adventure with an apocalyptic flavor. A manic genre mashup told across two broken realities. Step through the cracks: find your Exit.
70010000061751.name: Roman Sands RE:Build

70010000085030.description:
Join Bingo the dog, Scott the cat, Fidget the duck, Papo the frog and Tucker the racoon in a perilous multi-dimensional adventure! Dimensional Animals is a side-scrolling precision platformer about cute animal friends with crazy abilities. Swap between protagonists on the fly as you master each animal’s unique abilities to overcome obstacles and explore a massive interconnected map in retro pixel art style.

Run, jump, interact with the environment, use portals to discover new areas and uncover more skills! Find up to 50 hidden diamonds and 25 health orbs as you search every nook and cranny across beaches, over mountains and through waterworks. Can you help Bingo find and recover his play ball so he can return it to his human companion?

• Take control of 5 animal friends, each with unique abilities!
• Switch between playable characters on-the-fly.
• Run, jump, use portals, avoid traps and pounce on enemies!
• Discover loads of special secrets.
• Traverse mountains, beaches and other landscapes.
70010000085030.intro: Guide 5 animal friends through a pixelated retro adventure using their unique abilities to overcome precision platforming challenges!
70010000085030.name: Dimensional Animals

70010000101703.description:
Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River is a classic-style graphic adventure about a person adrift in space who is rescued by a luxurious space station orbiting Mars. Playing as River, you'll immerse yourself in a world of comfort and pleasure—until you realize the station hides a dark secret.

In Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River, you'll navigate the station's lavish leisure facilities, using your wits to solve puzzles and move forward. As the story unfolds, you’ll begin to uncover the sinister side of the station and must choose whether to ignore it or take action.

The choices you make in Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River will challenge your ethics and test your morality. Will you do whatever it takes to protect yourself and survive, or risk everything to expose the truth and stop what's happening on board?

The game's pixel art style creates a stunning, immersive world that captures the spirit of classic adventure games. From the luxurious amenities to the station’s shadowy corners, every location in Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River is full of character and ready to be explored. Its gripping story will keep you on the edge of your seat. With multiple endings to discover, this is a game you'll want to replay.

Are you ready to embark on a journey of self-discovery and uncover the dark secrets of the space station orbiting Mars?
70010000101703.intro: Uncover the dark truth behind a luxury space station orbiting Mars.
70010000101703.name: Welcome To Mars 9: The Tale Of River

70010000105770.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.
70010000105770.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000105770.name: Another Eden Begins

70010000113819.description:
Time To Usher In a Life As Ellie the Little Apprentice Witch!
• Step into the shoes of Ellie, an apprentice witch dispatched from Lucerine Ortu—a land of witches—and experience her journey of self development!
• Explore brand-new areas, craft potions and help the villagers. A heartwarming and cozy adventure awaits you here.
• Fish, gather, decorate your house, and interact with cats! We have all kinds of activities that will make every day an unforgettable experience.

Activities and Explorations as a Witch
• Navigate forests, caves, cliffs and lakes on your broom to meet adorable life forms and complete your Encyclopedia.
• Gather materials to craft problem-solving potions, discover hidden treasures and unlock new paths.

Stories of the Village and Its Inhabitants
• Work as an apprentice witch. Help out at the village and solve problems for the villagers.
• Make friends with the villagers as you restore the village. By establishing bonds, you can unlock their stories and even learn about their secrets.

Collections and Home Decoration
• Gather recipes and materials to craft furniture, which will give your living space a personal touch.
• Collect and customize brooms to add extra enjoyment to your explorations.

Laid-back Moments
• Spend your peaceful free time fishing and chatting. Interact with cats to deepen your cross-species friendships.
• Create your exclusive story in this magical yet ever so relatable world!
70010000113819.intro: Begin a cozy apprentice witch life in the woods with Ellie.
70010000113819.name: Little Witch in the Woods

70010000114916.description:
A new frontier in live-action suspense games, combining a multi-perspective visual novel where you switch between characters, high-quality live-action cinematics, and immersive 360° camera direction.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?
The choices determining how the story ends are now in your hands.


Game features:
Multiple Protagonists – Character Switching System
Freely switch between characters to experience the same timeline from multiple perspectives.
A single choice made by one character may change another’s fate.

Choose-Your-Own-Adventure System
The story branches according to your decisions.
A single choice can ripple across characters — and alter the ending.

360° View – Immersive Camera System
Step into each character’s point of view.
Look around freely through their eyes for a deeply immersive, cinematic experience.

FREEZE & ACTIVATE
Unlock frozen story paths through other characters.
When one story reaches a dead end, another character's story may hold the key to moving forward.

Buddy Characters
Meet colorful partner characters who accompany you throughout the story.

Cast:
Hiromitsu Kitayama / Game Creator: Daiki Shinjo
Sayuri Matsumura / Maid: Aoi Shinjo
Momoko Tanabe / Game Streamer: Yukimi Kurahashi
Misato Ugaki / Food Writer: Moe Kurosu
Yui Oguri (AKB48) / Underground Idol: Kokone Nagato
Azusa Ohara / Shrine Maiden: Chihiro Jimbo
MINA (East Of Eden) / Cosplayer: Wakana Yusa
70010000114916.intro: A live-action multi-perspective suspense game of fate and choice in Akihabara
70010000114916.name: AKIBA LOST

70010000121595.description:
Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

Tactile Satisfaction
Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.

A Warm Companion
With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.

Feed Your Inner Child
The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.

-The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
-Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
-Simple but deeply meaningful story
-The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
-Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
-Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile
70010000121595.intro: Woodo feels like a 3D coloring book you can touch, a relaxing tale told through handcrafted wooden dioramas.
70010000121595.name: Woodo

70010000128636.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.
70010000128636.intro: Now begins an RPG beyond time and space
70010000128636.name: Another Eden Begins Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

70010000136350.description:
Woodo is a cozy diorama puzzle game where you assemble wooden scenes piece by piece. As you place objects in their correct spots, each scene slowly fills with color and comes to life, revealing charming animations and small surprises. Follow the story of Foxy and Ben the frog through a series of interconnected dioramas, each capturing a unique moment from their shared adventure.

Tactile Satisfaction
Feel like you’re assembling a real toy, with each piece clicking into place with a satisfying, tactile sensation, as if it’s right in your hands.
Assembling objects isn’t linear—you have to turn and explore the 3D space to reveal hidden pieces. Watch as each piece transforms the world around you, with playful animations that react to your placements, bringing the diorama to life.

A Warm Companion
With a friendly narrator's voice, immerse yourself in a world when time was plentiful and much of it was spent outdoors, when the simplest things surprised and when every day promised great adventure. Feelings that were more present in childhood and are often missed or even forgotten with time passing.

Feed Your Inner Child
The game features funny and charming characters that create an atmosphere of carefree joy and humor, reminding you that happiness is what your inner child needs.

-Assemble beautiful dioramas piece by piece with a unique puzzle mechanic
-The game adapts to your pace, providing assistance when you need it
-Gameplay changes to adapt the narration
-Simple but deeply meaningful story
-The comforting voice of the narrator keeps you company
-Get carried away by nostalgic feelings of when things were simple
-Plenty of funny characters and silly animations make you smile
70010000136350.intro: Woodo is a cozy 3D puzzle matching game
70010000136350.name: Woodo - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

Includes all six episodes of the TV drama broadcast on Nippon TV, one of Japan's leading nationwide television networks!
Experience the world of AKIBA LOST through a unique live-action experience that offers a different perspective from the game.

Story
Thirteen years ago, six girls mysteriously disappeared in Akihabara — a series of unsolved cases known as "The Akiba Vanishing".

At the annual Tokyo Game Expo, Daiki Shinjo (played by Hiromitsu Kitayama), once hailed as a "genius creator," boldly announces the development of a new game inspired by this very incident: AKIBA LOST.
But soon thereafter, the strange disappearances begin again.

The cast of the game includes his sister Aoi Shinjo, who works at a maid cafe, underground idol Kokone Nagato, food writer Moe Kurosu, shrine maiden Chihiro Jimbo, cosplayer Wakana Yusa, and game streamer Yukimi Kurahashi — each a colorful icon of Akihabara’s vibrant subculture.

The story they were supposed to perform soon begins to bleed into reality.
It all starts with a threatening phone call — and the sudden disappearance of Aoi.

"Stop developing the game now. Or else...the tragedy will repeat again."

Can Shinjo finish developing the game? Can he protect everyone? Who is behind it all? And what really happened 13 years ago?
